title: A voyage changes captains
hook: Did Magellan complete the first circumnavigation?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: The route continued after its first commander died in the Philippines.

claims.text: 1519: Spain. A fleet leaves to seek the Spice Islands.
claims.source: https://artsandculture.google.com/story/magellan-s-expedition-and-elcano-s-first-circumnavigation-of-the-globe/-gVBFYTKUG3YLg — Fundación Elkano exhibition: departure, strait, Philippines, Elcano return

claims.text: 1520: Strait. Ships find a passage into the Pacific.
claims.source: https://artsandculture.google.com/story/magellan-s-expedition-and-elcano-s-first-circumnavigation-of-the-globe/-gVBFYTKUG3YLg — Fundación Elkano exhibition: departure, strait, Philippines, Elcano return

claims.text: 1521: Philippines. Magellan dies; the voyage continues.
claims.source: https://artsandculture.google.com/story/magellan-s-expedition-and-elcano-s-first-circumnavigation-of-the-globe/-gVBFYTKUG3YLg — Fundación Elkano exhibition: departure, strait, Philippines, Elcano return

claims.text: 1522: Homeward. Elcano returns westward around Africa.
claims.source: https://artsandculture.google.com/story/magellan-s-expedition-and-elcano-s-first-circumnavigation-of-the-globe/-gVBFYTKUG3YLg — Fundación Elkano exhibition: departure, strait, Philippines, Elcano return

claims.text: The route continued after its first commander died in the Philippines. Elcano captained Victoria back across the Indian Ocean and around Africa to Spain in 1522. Circumnavigation was the outcome of a changing expedition and its crews, not one person sailing the whole loop.
claims.source: https://artsandculture.google.com/story/magellan-s-expedition-and-elcano-s-first-circumnavigation-of-the-globe/-gVBFYTKUG3YLg — Fundación Elkano exhibition: departure, strait, Philippines, Elcano return

recall.question: Who commanded Victoria on its return?
recall.why: The route continued after its first commander died in the Philippines. Elcano captained Victoria back across the Indian Ocean and around Africa to Spain in 1522. Circumnavigation was the outcome of a changing expedition and its crews, not one person sailing the whole loop.
